column1: # Camera Raw's default exposure offset per camera body, for DNG Standard
#   make <TAB> model|alias|alias <TAB> offset in EV <TAB> lowest native ISO (or empty)
# From RAWmakase data/cameras.toml @ 7c3c81ab (2026-10-17): make, model, aliases,
# baseline_exposure and lowest_iso of every row; 230 bodies across 10 makes.
# Names are LibRaw's, matched to rawler's in letters and digits only.
# Each value is the BaselineExposure Camera Raw gives an unedited photo with
# Adobe Standard, adjusted for the difference between Adobe's white level and the
# decoder's. The first version of this table carried RAWmakase's adjustment for
# LibRaw's white level. Argentum decodes with rawler, whose white level differs
#   Nikon, Olympus, OM Digital, Panasonic DC-GH5S: rawler's TOML whitepoint is
#     Adobe's, so these 42 rows are Adobe's own BaselineExposure, from RAWmakase
#     data/cameras.toml @ a8c5d6d7 (v0.4.0, 2026-10-19), which dropped the LibRaw
#     adjustment when it began reading Adobe's levels.
#   Canon: rawler takes the file's SpecularWhiteLevel, as LibRaw did (Adobe takes
#     NormalWhiteLevel, by ISO speed), so Canon keeps the 7c3c81ab values.
#   Every other make: unchanged between the two RAWmakase versions.
# From the tables only; no photo has been rendered to check these yet.
